title: echinocereus enneacanthus subsp. intermedius
intro: Echinocereus enneacanthus subsp. intermedius, commonly known as the Silver Pincushion, is a cactus species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The therapeutic actions of Echinocereus enneacanthus subsp. intermedius are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. However, there is limited scientific information available on the specific therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents of this plant.
